name: eon-ticket
effect: Provides access to Southern Island and either Latias or Latios, whichever is not available roaming around Hoenn.
shortEffect: Provides access to Southern Island and Latias or Latios.

flavorTextEntries.text: The ticket for a ferry to a distant southern island.
The ticket required for sailing on a ferry to a distant southern island. It features a drawing of an island.
The ticket required for sailing on a ferry to the Southern Island. Does Norman, the Petalburg Gym Leader, know a secret?!
